evidence.observation: Pressure 2.938 Torr at start of growth, matching the ramp baseline of about 2.94 Torr.
Pressure rose steadily to 3.208 Torr (+0.27 Torr over 720 s) and the rise is speeding up.
Ar flow stayed at the 100 sccm setpoint, so the pressure rise is not caused by extra flow.
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C with heater power steady at about 45%, so temperature control looks normal.
O2 sensor not installed, so the growth-stage atmosphere cannot be verified and a leak cannot be told apart from a blockage.
